about: Cluster profiles for VASP job scripts: generic starting points. Put your own in ~/CAPS/dft-clusters.json (same format; a profile there replaces one of the same name), or edit them in Settings › DFT clusters. No e-mail lines are ever written. 'parallel' rules are tried in order: the first whose max_atoms is not exceeded gives MPI ranks, KPAR, NCORE and the time limit; 'gamma' is used for Γ-only runs (a molecule in a box). 'hang' is the seconds without VASP output after which the watchdog restarts a stage, by size.
